scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply stashit-auth --local --migrations-dir=db/migrations && wrangler d1 migrations apply stashit-template --local --migrations-dir=db/migrations
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply stashit-auth --remote --migrations-dir=db/migrations && wrangler d1 migrations apply stashit-template --remote --migrations-dir=db/migrations
scripts.db:setup: bun run db:generate && bun run db:migrate:local
